summary: No relevant testing skill found. Simulated installed PWA standalone mode by overriding display-mode: standalone and tested the patient Android-app flow. The main install/marketing confusion is mostly fixed: no install banner in standalone, /paziente opens the mockup patient home, marketing routes redirect to /paziente, marketing header stays hidden, bottom nav/profile/diario work, and normal browser mode still shows the legacy dashboard plus marketing site. However the app experience is not fully fixed because standalone Chat cannot send messages correctly.

critical.issue: Message send from the new standalone ChatMobilePage returns 422 Unprocessable Entity. Code review confirms backend MessaggioInput requires destinatario_id, while ChatMobilePage posts conversazione_id + testo.

ui_bugs.issue: The chat input/send form is physically underneath the fixed bottom nav in mobile standalone layout. elementFromPoint at the send button center returns nav-profilo, so real mobile taps can hit the bottom nav instead of Send.

integration_issues.flow: Standalone PWA > /paziente/chat > send message to therapist
integration_issues.issue: 1:1 conversation opens, but sending a message fails with /api/messaggi 422 because the frontend sends the wrong payload field and no message is persisted.

action_items: Fix ChatMobilePage send payload to POST /api/messaggi with destinatario_id (selected.terapeuta_id for paziente, selected.paziente_id for therapist) instead of conversazione_id.
Move the standalone chat composer above the fixed bottom nav or add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area handling so Send is tappable on Android-sized screens.
Retest standalone chat send end-to-end and confirm the sent text appears after reload.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/pages/patient/ChatMobilePage.jsx lines 47-50 post { conversazione_id, testo }, but /app/backend/server.py lines 225-227 and 382-399 require { destinatario_id, testo }.
ChatMobilePage uses h-screen inside PazienteAppShell while BottomNav is fixed; on 390x844 viewport the send button rect is y=788-832 and bottom nav rect is y=752-844.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. A chat send attempt was made but failed with 422, so no message was persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use standalone matchMedia override. Already verified: no PWA install banner in standalone even with just-registered/beforeinstallprompt; PazienteHome mockup visible; /, /blog, /chi-siamo, /terapeuti redirect to /paziente in standalone; public header hidden; tabs/profile/diario work; normal browser legacy dashboard and /blog work. Focus next retest on /paziente/chat send after fixing payload and bottom-nav overlap.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: simulate standalone, login as demo.paziente@funzionabene.it / paziente2026, open /paziente/chat, type a message, tap Send. The UI sends POST /api/messaggi with conversazione_id instead of destinatario_id, producing 422 and a runtime error overlay. Additionally, the fixed bottom nav overlaps the chat composer on mobile, so the app still does not feel like a reliable dedicated patient app. No APIs were mocked.
